blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Queen Mary Park rose from 79 in June to 89 in September (+12.7%), and 37 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 5.8% of Surrey’s 1,523 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Queen Mary Park?
Queen Mary Park also had 71 houses listed and 2 sold in September, against 89 condos and townhomes listed. The Queen Mary Park houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Queen Mary Park?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 89 condos and townhomes listed in Queen Mary Park. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Queen Mary Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Queen Mary Park had a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Queen Mary Park from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 37 condos and townhomes sold in Queen Mary Park over those 4 months, out of 591 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
